name: 17 锁定延迟（重力触底 0.5s 缓冲不即时锁；15 次重置上限强制锁）

asserts.source:
local logs = query.logs()
local ldAt, lockAt = 0, 0
for i, l in ipairs(logs) do
  if l:match('^ldstart') and ldAt == 0 then ldAt = i end
  if l:match('^lock ') and lockAt == 0 then lockAt = i end
end
assert(ldAt > 0, 'no ldstart')
assert(lockAt == 0, 'locked before delay! lockAt=' .. lockAt .. ' ldAt=' .. ldAt)
return true

asserts.contains: clear n=2 score=300 lines=2 combo=1 b2b=0
